minor.issue: Function _record_pending_transaction is defined twice (lines ~91 and ~155). Currently no impact on this iter's tests since checkout still records the package_id; suggest deleting the duplicate at lines 155-172.

action_items: Investigate why tier-upgrade-btn from VideoChallenge TierLockOverlay routes to /missions (or onboarding tour intercepts). Verify navigate('/coaching') is invoked.
Remove duplicate _record_pending_transaction definition in /app/backend/routes/payments.py (lines 155-172) — the second redefinition drops tier+billing fields from inserted document.
critical_code_review_comments: services_tier.TIER_CONFIG cleanly mirrors wladhub.com pricing with explicit feature flags per tier. video_analysis correctly gated only on accelerator. require_feature raises HTTPException(402) with structured detail — frontend can parse this directly.

Duplicate _record_pending_transaction in routes/payments.py is a code-smell: Python keeps only the second def. Currently the function is called from create_checkout (line 211) — the active variant lacks tier+billing fields written into payment_transactions. This will hurt analytics and could cause webhook _handle_installment_payment lookup to miss billing=='installment_followup' for non-followup installments. Recommend deleting lines 155-172.
_create_installment_checkout properly tags transactions with billing='installment_followup' and installment_num for webhook routing — good design.
cron/installments-due is dedup-safe via email_log type='installment_due_{n}' — won't double-send for same installment.

Frontend TierBadge appears twice on dashboard (once near user name, once in sidebar footer) — both use data-testid='tier-badge-free'. Consider differentiating testids (e.g., 'tier-badge-header' / 'tier-badge-sidebar') for unambiguous targeting.
